info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Advertising Id-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update marketing information associated with a specific advertising ID. It facilitates the modification of key data points, enabling businesses to tailor their marketing strategies effectively. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and application developers looking to enhance user targeting and campaign management. By leveraging this functionality, organizations can ensure that their marketing efforts remain current and aligned with their overall business objectives.
